finalText:
Build's clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands modules `{ retryCount }`, so it threw on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. The bumped config loader now leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it started throwing. Treated `undefined` as disabled, matching the old default.

The rest (DEP0142/DEP0198/etc., unused-export, circular-import warnings) are pre-existing deprecation/lint noise from the bump, not build-breaking — left alone.
